snippet.title: Emblems: Sunless Vow - Official Gameplay Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Can they stop arguing long enough to escape the void?! Watch the latest Emblems: Sunless Vow trailer for this roguelike visual novel with turn-based combat and flexible difficulty. The new Emblems: Sunless Vow trailer shows gameplay and what you can expect. Calculate, power-up, and stack favors to The Heart's content... Or take on a narrative campaign filled with Mystery + Drama + Shenanigans. Emblems: Sunless Vow will be available on PC.
